content.text: When a user does not have permission to edit a Contract but does have the "Automatic Related Contract Update For Product" permission, what should happen when they create a new Product version? Should the related Contract be updated automatically as well?

When all Contract Edit permissions are disabled, but "Automatic Related Contract Update for Product" is enabled, should the system create a new version of the contract, or should it not perform any update at all?
Currently, when Contract Edit permissions are disabled and "Automatic Related Contract Update" is enabled, the system updates the existing contract version, but it does not create a new version.
Could you please clarify the expected behavior?

if the permission for "Automatic Related Contract Update for Product" is enabled, than  everything regarding the related contracts update should work the same as if the user has all necessary edit contract permissions.
